candidates.label: Crisis-invocation sincerity and istidraj: Him alone invoked in distress removing affliction forgetting associates; forgotten reminder opens doors abundance then sudden seizure at rejoicing producing despair
candidates.definition: In 6:41-44: It is Him alone you invoke and He removes that for which you invoked Him if He wills and you forget what you associate. So when they forgot that by which they had been reminded We opened to them the doors of everything until when they rejoiced in what they were given We seized them suddenly and they were in despair.

evidence.excerpt: بَلۡ إِيَّاهُ تَدۡعُونَ فَيَكۡشِفُ مَا تَدۡعُونَ إِلَيۡهِ إِن شَآءَ وَتَنسَوۡنَ مَا تُشۡرِكُونَ
evidence.rationale: Bal iyyahu tadAAoona fayakshifu ma tadAAoona ilayhi in shaa watansawna ma tushrikoona: crisis reveals true object of reliance as associates are involuntarily forgotten under genuine duress.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَمَّا نَسُواْ مَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِهِۦ فَتَحۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَرِحُواْ بِمَآ أُوتُوٓاْ أَخَذۡنَٰهُم بَغۡتَةٗ فَإِذَا هُم مُّبۡلِسُونَ
evidence.rationale: Falamma nasoo ma thukkiroo bihi fatahna AAalayhim abwaba kulli shayin hatta itha farihoo bima ootoo akhathnahum baghtatan faitha hum mublisoona: istidraj mechanism where forgotten reminder triggers abundance-proliferation culminating in sudden seizure at peak false-security.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Experiential tawheed proof through involuntary crisis-reliance

candidates.urduLabel: إخلاص الدعاء في الأزمات والاستدراج: إياه تدعون فيكشف الضر وتنسون الشركاء؛ نسيان الذكر يفتح أبواب الرخاء ثم أخذ بغتة عند الفرح فيصيب اليأس
candidates.notes: Overlap with tawheed and hardship-and-ease. Crisis-invocation (6:41) provides strongest experiential tawheed evidence: polytheists themselves abandon associates when genuinely threatened. Istidraj (6:44) explains delayed punishment as deliberate divine pedagogy not neglect. Abwaba kulli shayin (doors of everything) indicates comprehensive material prosperity making subsequent reversal more devastating. Baghtatan-mublisoona pairing shows suddenness produces total psychological collapse. Together these verses demonstrate that divine patience operates through structured pedagogical sequence.

candidates.label: Sensory-deprivation hypothetical: if Allah took hearing sight sealed hearts which deity besides Allah could restore? sign-diversification met with persistent turning away
candidates.definition: In 6:46: Say have you considered if Allah should take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal upon your hearts which deity other than Allah could bring them back to you? Look how We diversify the verses then they still turn away.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِنۡ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ سَمۡعَكُمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرَكُمۡ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِكُم مَّنۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِ يَأۡتِيكُم بِهِۗ ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ ثُمَّ هُمۡ يَصۡدِفُونَ
evidence.rationale: Qul araaytum in akhatha Allahu samAAakum waabsarakum wakhatama AAala quloobikum man ilahun ghayru Allahi yateekum bihi: triple-faculty deprivation hypothetical using rhetorical question format forcing acknowledgment that no created being can restore lost capacities. Onthur kayfa nusarrifu alayati thumma hum yasdifoona: sign-diversification explicitly noted yet aversion persists proving rejection is volitional not evidential.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Reductio ad absurdum against polytheism through faculty-dependency argument

candidates.urduLabel: فرضية الحرمان الحسي: لو أخذ الله السمع والأبصار وختم على القلوب أي إله غير الله يردها؟ تصريف الآيات يواجه بالإعراض المستمر
candidates.notes: Overlap with tawheed. Triple-faculty deprivation (hearing sight heart-seal) covers all channels of divine communication making the hypothetical maximally forceful. Man ilahun ghayru Allahi construction excludes all possible alternatives through interrogative negation. Nusarrifu (diversify) implies multiple sign-types already presented yet yasdifoona (turn away) shows systematic rejection regardless of sign modality. This verse functions as philosophical argument accessible to any rational agent independent of revelation-content.

candidates.label: Messenger-function restriction: messengers sent only as glad-tidings-bearers and warners; belief-reformation yields freedom from fear grief; prophet disavows treasuries unseen-knowledge angel-status follows only revelation
candidates.definition: In 6:48-50: We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. Whoever believes and reforms there will be no fear concerning them nor will they grieve. Say I do not tell you I have the depositories of Allah or know the unseen or am an angel. I only follow what is revealed to me.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَا نُرۡسِلُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرِينَ وَمُنذِرِينَۖ فَمَنۡ ءَامَنَ وَأَصۡلَحَ فَلَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يَحۡزَنُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wama nursilu almursaleena illa mubashshireena wamunthireena: messenger-function restricted to dual role excluding supernatural intervention or political authority. Faman amana waaslaha fala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona: belief-reformation pairing producing existential security.

evidence.excerpt: قُل لَّآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡ عِندِي خَزَآئِنُ ٱللَّهِ وَلَآ أَعۡلَمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبَ وَلَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡ إِنِّي مَلَكٌۖ إِنۡ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّۚ قُلۡ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِي ٱلۡأَعۡمَىٰ وَٱلۡبَصِيرُۚ أَفَلَا تَتَفَكَّرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Qul la aqoolu lakum AAindee khazainu Allahi wala aAAlamu alghayba wala aqoolu lakum innee malakun: triple-disavowal eliminating treasury-access unseen-knowledge and angel-status claims. In attabiAAu illa ma yooha ilayya: revelation-following as sole authority basis.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Prophetic office defined through functional restriction and disavowal

candidates.urduLabel: تحديد وظيفة الرسول: الرسل مبشرون ومنذرون فقط؛ الإيمان والإصلاح يزيلان الخوف والحزن؛ النبي يتبرأ من خزائن الغيب وكونه ملكاً ويتبع الوحي فقط
candidates.notes: Overlap with prophets. Illa mubashshireena wamunthireena construction uses exclusive restriction eliminating all other expected messenger-functions. Khazain-ghayb-malak triple disavowal addresses three major Meccan objections systematically. In attabiAAu illa ma yooha establishes wahy as sole epistemic foundation distinguishing prophet from mystic or ruler. Fear-grief removal (6:48) provides psychological outcome of proper belief-response creating incentive structure.

candidates.label: Community ethics and social-testing: do not drive away morning-evening supplicants seeking His face; mutual non-accountability; tested some by others exposing elitist assumptions; Allah knows best who are grateful
candidates.definition: In 6:52-53: Do not send away those who call upon their Lord morning and afternoon seeking His countenance. Not upon you is anything of their account nor upon them anything of your account. Thus We have tried some of them through others that they might say is it these whom Allah has favored among us? Is not Allah most knowing of those who grateful?

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تَطۡرُدِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلۡغَدَوٰةِ وَٱلۡعَشِيِّ يُرِيدُونَ وَجۡهَهُۥۖ مَا عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ حِسَابِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖ وَمَا مِنۡ حِسَابِكَ عَلَيۡهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖ فَتَطۡرُدَهُمۡ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Wala tatrudi allatheena yadAAoona rabbahum bialghadati waalAAashiyyi yureedoona wajhahu: prohibition protecting vulnerable believers whose spiritual dedication (morning-evening supplication, face-seeking) outweighs social status. Ma AAalayka min hisabihim min shayin: mutual non-accountability establishing that Prophet bears no responsibility for their worldly condition.

evidence.excerpt: وَكَذَٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعۡضَهُم بِبَعۡضٖ لِّيَقُولُوٓاْ أَهَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِم مِّنۢ بَيۡنِنَآۗ أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَعۡلَمَ بِٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
evidence.rationale: Wakathalika fatanna baAAdahum bibaAAdin: social stratification framed as deliberate divine test not random inequality. Liyaqooloo ahaolai manna Allahu AAalayhim min baynina: exposes elitist assumption that divine favor correlates with wealth. Alaysa Allahu biaAAlama bialshshakireena: divine knowledge of gratitude supersedes human social judgment.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Social hierarchy as test of taqwa-based values versus materialist assumptions

candidates.urduLabel: أخلاق المجتمع والامتحان الاجتماعي: لا تطرد الذين يدعون ربهم بالغداة والعشي يريدون وجهه؛ عدم المحاسبة المتبادلة؛ امتحان البعض بالبعض لكشف النزعة الطبقية؛ الله أعلم بالشاكرين
candidates.notes: Overlap with god-consciousness. Morning-evening supplication pattern (bialghadati waalAAashiyyi) indicates sustained devotion not performative piety. Yureedoona wajhahu (seeking His face) specifies pure intention distinguishing these believers from status-seekers. Fatanna (tested) reframes poverty as potential sign of divine selection reversing worldly value hierarchy. BiaAAlama bialshshakireena establishes gratitude as true metric of divine favor inaccessible to human observation.

candidates.label: Self-decreed mercy and repentance pathway: greet believers with peace Lord decreed mercy on Himself; evil done in ignorance then repents reforms He is Forgiving Merciful; sign-detailing makes criminal way evident
candidates.definition: In 6:54-55: When those who believe in Our verses come to you say peace be upon you. Your Lord has decreed upon Himself mercy that whoever does evil in ignorance then repents and reforms indeed He is Forgiving Merciful. Thus We detail the verses so the way of the criminals becomes evident.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا جَآءَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَقُلۡ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمۡ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَةَ أَنَّهُۥ مَنۡ عَمِلَ مِنكُمۡ سُوٓءَۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٖ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ وَأَصۡلَحَ فَأَنَّهُۥ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Faqul salamun AAalaykum kataba rabbukum AAala nafsihi alrrahmata: greeting-mercy linkage anchoring community welcome in divine self-commitment. Annahu man AAamila minkum sooan bijahalatin thumma taba min baAAdihi waaslaha faannahu ghafoorun raheemun: repentance conditions (ignorance + tawbah + islah) preventing both despair and presumption.

evidence.excerpt: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ وَلِتَسۡتَبِينَ سَبِيلُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
evidence.rationale: Wakathalika nufassilu alayati walitastabeena sabeelu almujrimeena: sign-detailing serves diagnostic function making criminal-pathway recognizable and avoidable.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Structured repentance pathway with explicit conditions and divine self-commitment
Self-decreed mercy as foundation for forgiveness availability

candidates.urduLabel: الرحمة المكتوبة ومسار التوبة: سلموا على المؤمنين كتب ربكم على نفسه الرحمة؛ من عمل سوءاً بجهالة ثم تاب وأصلح فهو غفور رحيم؛ تفصيل الآيات يستبين سبيل المجرمين
candidates.notes: Overlap with repentance and mercy-and-forgiveness. Kataba AAala nafsihi alrrahmata repetition (cf. 6:12) reinforces mercy as structural divine commitment not contingent response. Bijahalatin qualifier prevents misuse: intentional persistent sin excluded from this pathway. Taba-waaslaha pairing requires both internal repentance and external reformation. Ghafur-Raheem conclusion provides dual assurance covering past erasure and future compassion. Sabeelu almujrimeena clarity enables proactive avoidance complementing reactive repentance.

candidates.label: Comprehensive unseen-knowledge and continuous oversight: keys of unseen none knows except Him; knows land sea falling leaf grain in darkness moist dry all in clear record; takes souls night knows daytime deeds revives for specified term then return and informing
candidates.definition: In 6:59-60: With Him are the keys of the unseen none knows them except Him. He knows what is on land and in the sea. Not a leaf falls but He knows it nor a grain within the darknesses of the earth nor anything moist or dry but in a clear record. He takes your souls by night and knows what you committed by day then revives you therein that a specified term may be fulfilled then to Him is your return then He will inform you about what you used to do.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَعِندَهُۥ مَفَاتِحُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ لَا يَعۡلَمُهَآ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلۡبَرِّ وَٱلۡبَحۡرِۚ وَمَا تَسۡقُطُ مِن وَرَقَةٍ إِلَّا يَعۡلَمُهَا وَلَا حَبَّةٖ فِي ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا رَطۡبٖ وَلَا يَابِسٍ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبٖ مُّبِينٖ
evidence.rationale: WaAAindahu mafatihu alghaybi la yaAAlamuha illa huwa: exclusive unseen-access establishing epistemic monopoly. WayaAAlamu ma fee albarri waalbahri wama tasqutu min waraqatin illa yaAAlamuha wala habbatin fee thulumati alardi wala ratbin wala yabisin illa fee kitabin mubeenin: micro-scale comprehensiveness (leaf grain darkness moisture) demonstrating knowledge penetrates all scales and conditions.

evidence.excerpt: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا جَرَحۡتُم بِٱلنَّهَارِ ثُمَّ يَبۡعَثُكُمۡ فِيهِ لِيُقۡضَىٰٓ أَجَلٞ مُّسَمّٗىۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wahuwa allathee yatawaffakum biallayli wayaAAlamu ma jarahtum bialnnahari: night-day cycle establishing continuous engagement. Thumma yabAAathukum feehi liyuqda ajalun musamman thumma ilayhi marjiAAukum thumma yunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona: term-fulfillment return-informing sequence completing accountability framework.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Omniscience demonstrated through exhaustive enumeration across all domains

candidates.urduLabel: علم الغيب الشامل والرقابة المستمرة: مفاتيح الغيب لا يعلمها إلا هو؛ يعلم البر والبحر وسقوط الورقة والحب في الظلمات والرطب واليابس في كتاب مبين؛ يتوفى الأنفس ليلاً ويعلم جراح النهار ويبعث لقضاء أجل مسمى ثم المرجع والإنباء
candidates.notes: Overlap with divine-power. Mafatihu alghaybi (keys of unseen) metaphor suggests locked repositories accessible only to divine holder. Leaf-grain-darkness enumeration moves from visible to hidden from large to small demonstrating no scale escapes. Kitab mubeen (clear record) provides archival mechanism ensuring nothing lost. Yatawaffakum-yabAAathukum cycle mirrors nightly death-daily resurrection prefiguring eschatological pattern. Yunabbiokum (inform) promises complete disclosure closing accountability loop.

candidates.label: Post-rescue ingratitude and punishment-forms: Allah saves from every distress then you associate; Able to send punishment from above below or confuse into sects tasting violence one another; diversify signs for understanding
candidates.definition: In 6:64-65: Say Allah saves you from it and from every distress then you associate others with Him. Say He is the Able to send upon you affliction from above you or from beneath your feet or to confuse you into sects and make you taste the violence of one another. Look how We diversify the signs that they might understand.

evidence.excerpt: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُنَجِّيكُم مِّنۡهَا وَمِن كُلِّ كَرۡبٖ ثُمَّ أَنتُمۡ تُشۡرِكُونَ
evidence.rationale: Quli Allahu yunajjeekum minha wamin kulli karbin thumma antum tushrikoona: rescue-ingratitude sequence using thumma (then) marking temporal-causal betrayal. Min kulli karbin extends rescue scope beyond specific crisis to all distress.

evidence.excerpt: قُلۡ هُوَ ٱلۡقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبۡعَثَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابٗا مِّن فَوۡقِكُمۡ أَوۡ مِن تَحۡتِ أَرۡجُلِكُمۡ أَوۡ يَلۡبِسَكُمۡ شِيَعٗا وَيُذِيقَ بَعۡضَكُم بَأۡسَ بَعۡضٍۗ ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَفۡقَهُونَ
evidence.rationale: Qul huwa alqadiru AAala an yabAAatha AAalaykum AAathaban min fawqikum aw min tahti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiyaAAan wayutheeqa baAAdakum basa baAAdin: three punishment-forms (above below sectarian-confusion) covering all spatial-social dimensions. Onthur kayfa nusarrifu alayati laAAallahum yafqahoona: diversification aimed at understanding (yafqahoona) not merely seeing.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Multi-modal punishment capability demonstrating comprehensive divine agency
Post-rescue shirk as violation of experientially proven tawheed

candidates.urduLabel: نكران الجميل بعد الإنجاة وأشكال العذاب: الله ينجي من كل كرب ثم تشركون؛ قادر على إرسال عذاب من فوق أو تحت أو لبس شيع وإذاقة بأس بعضكم ببعض؛ تصريف الآيات للفقه
candidates.notes: Overlap with divine-power and tawheed. Thumma antum tushrikoona uses emphatic antum highlighting agency in betrayal: rescue-recipients actively choose ingratitude. Three punishment-forms cover vertical (above-below) and horizontal (sectarian) dimensions leaving no escape vector. Yalbisakum shiyaAAan (confuse into sects) uniquely identifies internal division as divine chastisement distinct from external calamity. Yafqahoona (understand) targets cognitive faculty suggesting signs are intelligible to willing minds.

candidates.label: Religion-as-play and soul-forfeiture: leave those taking religion as play amusement deluded by worldly life; remind lest soul given up for earned no protector intercessor ransom accepted; boiling water painful punishment for disbelief
candidates.definition: In 6:70: Leave those who take their religion as play and amusement and whom the worldly life has deluded. Remind with it lest a soul be given up for what it earned. It will have besides Allah no protector nor intercessor. If it offered every compensation it would not be accepted. Those are given up for what they earned. For them is a drink of scalding water and painful punishment because they disbelieved.

evidence.excerpt: وَذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُواْ دِينَهُمۡ لَعِبٗا وَلَهۡوٗا وَغَرَّتۡهُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَذَكِّرۡ بِهِۦٓ أَن تُبۡسَلَ نَفۡسُۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيّٞ وَلَا شَفِيعٞ وَإِن تَعۡدِلۡ كُلَّ عَدۡلٖ لَّا يُؤۡخَذۡ مِنۡهَآۗ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُبۡسِلُواْ بِمَا كَسَبُواْۖ لَهُمۡ شَرَابٞ مِّنۡ حَمِيمٖ وَعَذَابٌ أَلِيمُۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡفُرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wathari allatheena ittakhathoo deenahum laAAiban walahwan wagharrathumu alhayatu alddunya: religion-trivialization diagnosed as play-amusement rooted in dunya-delusion. Wathakkir bihi an tubsala nafsun bima kasabat: reminder-purpose preventing soul-forfeiture (tubsala) tied to personal earnings. Laysa laha min dooni Allahi waliyyun wala shafeeAAun wain taAAdil kulla AAadlin la yukhath minha: triple-negation (no protector no intercessor no ransom-acceptance) eliminating all escape routes. Lahum sharabun min hameemin waAAathabun aleemun bima kanoo yakfuroona: punishment-specification linked causally to disbelief.

candidates.urduLabel: الدين لعب ولهو ومهجة النفس: ذر الذين اتخذوا دينهم لعباً ولهواً وغرتهم الحياة الدنيا؛ ذكر لئلا تبسل نفس بما كسبت لا ولي ولا شفيع ولا عدل يؤخذ؛ شراب من حميم وعذاب أليم بالكفر
candidates.notes: Overlap with the-hereafter. LaAAiban walahwan pairing identifies two modes of religion-trivialization: active mockery and passive distraction. Gharrathumu alhayatu alddunya locates root cause in dunya-deception not mere intellectual error. Tubsala (given up/surrendered) uses rare root emphasizing irreversible forfeiture. Triple-negation structure systematically eliminates hoped-for intermediaries. Hameem (scalding water) provides sensory-specific punishment imagery intensifying deterrent effect. Bima kanoo yakfuroona establishes causal link between persistent disbelief-state and punishment-outcome.

candidates.label: Ibrahim's tawheed-journey: confronted father Azar over idol-worship manifest error; shown kingdom heavens earth for certainty; observed star moon sun each rejected upon setting; declared bara'a from associates turned face to Fatir as hanif
candidates.definition: In 6:74-79: When Ibrahim said to his father Azar do you take idols as deities? I see you and your people in manifest error. Thus We showed Ibrahim the realm of heavens and earth that he would be among the certain. When night covered him he saw a star said this is my lord; when it set said I love not those that set. When he saw moon rising said this is my lord; when it set said unless my Lord guides me I will be among astray. When he saw sun rising said this is my lord this is greater; when it set said O my people I am free from what you associate. I have turned my face toward He who originated heavens and earth as hanif and I am not of the polytheists.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ ءَازَرَ أَتَتَّخِذُ أَصۡنَامًا ءَالِهَةً إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰكَ وَقَوۡمَكَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
evidence.rationale: Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi azara atattakhithu asnaman alihatan innee araka waqawmaka fee dalalin mubeenin: filial confrontation combining respect (addressing father) with uncompromising truth-declaration (manifest error).

evidence.excerpt: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُرِيٓ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ مَلَكُوتَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلِيَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُوقِنِينَ
evidence.rationale: Wakathalika nuree ibraheema malakoota alssamawati waalardi waliyakoona mina almooqineena: kingdom-vision as divine grant producing certainty (yiqin) not mere intellectual conclusion.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَمَّا جَنَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلَّيۡلُ رَءَا كَوۡكَبٗاۖ قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّيۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَآ أُحِبُّ ٱلۡأٓفِلِينَ
evidence.rationale: Falamma janna AAalayhi allaylu raa kawkaban qala hatha rabbee falamma afala qala la ohibbu alafileena: first observation-setting cycle establishing transience-criterion for deity-rejection.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلۡقَمَرَ بَازِغٗا قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّيۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَ قَالَ لَئِن لَّمۡ يَهۡدِنِي رَبِّي لَأَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
evidence.rationale: Falamma raa alqamara bazighan qala hatha rabbee falamma afala qala lain lam yahdinee rabbee laakoonanna mina alqawmi alddalleena: second cycle adding guidance-dependence acknowledgment.

evidence.excerpt: فَلَمَّا رَءَا ٱلشَّمۡسَ بَازِغَةٗ قَالَ هَٰذَا رَبِّي هَٰذَآ أَكۡبَرُۖ فَلَمَّآ أَفَلَتۡ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تُشۡرِكُونَ
evidence.rationale: Falamma raa alshshamsa bazighatan qala hatha rabbee hatha akbaru falamma afalat qala ya qawmi innee bareeon mimma tushrikoona: third cycle with greatest-candidate then public bara'a declaration.

evidence.excerpt: إِنِّي وَجَّهۡتُ وَجۡهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ حَنِيفٗاۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
evidence.rationale: Innee wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fatara alssamawati waalarda haneefan wama ana mina almushrikeena: positive orientation (face-turning to Fatir) combined with negative disavowal (not mushrikeen) completing tawheed-declaration.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Core Ibrahim tawheed-discovery narrative with empirical methodology
Paradigmatic rational-monotheism discovery through observation and elimination

candidates.urduLabel: مسيرة إبراهيم التوحيدية: واجه أباه آزر على عبادة الأصنام ضلال مبين؛ أُري ملكوت السماوات والأرض لليقين؛ رصد الكوكب والقمر والشمس ورفض كل منها عند أفولها؛ تبرأ من الشركاء ووجه وجهه للفطر حنيفاً
candidates.notes: Overlap with ibrahim-story and tawheed. Three-stage celestial observation models empirical methodology accessible to any rational observer. Each stage escalates candidate-plausibility (star < moon < sun) yet all fail transience-test. La ohibbu alafileena expresses affective rejection not merely intellectual. Lain lam yahdinee rabbee acknowledges guidance-dependence preventing self-sufficient rationalism. Ya qawmi address marks transition from private inquiry to public proclamation. Hanif designation connects Ibrahim to primordial monotheism predating revealed scripture.

candidates.label: Security-injustice linkage: Ibrahim argues from divine-guidance fears not associates unless Lord wills; Lord encompasses all in knowledge reflect; those who believed did not mix belief with injustice have security are guided
candidates.definition: In 6:80: His people argued with him. He said do you argue with me concerning Allah while He has guided me? I fear not what you associate unless my Lord wills something. My Lord encompasses all things in knowledge; will you not remember? Those who believed and did not mix their belief with injustice those have security and they are guided.

evidence.excerpt: وَحَآجَّهُۥ قَوۡمُهُۥۚ قَالَ أَتُحَـٰٓجُّوٓنِّي فِي ٱللَّهِ وَقَدۡ هَدَىٰنِۚ وَلَآ أَخَافُ مَا تُشۡرِكُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ رَبِّي شَيۡـٔٗاۚ وَسِعَ رَبِّي كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ عِلۡمًاۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wahajjahu qawmuhu qala atuhajjoonnee fee Allahi waqad hadani: argumentative confidence grounded in received guidance not personal opinion. Wala akhafu ma tushrikoona bihi illa an yashaa rabbee shayan: fearlessness toward associates conditioned only on divine will establishing absolute sovereignty. WasiaAa rabbee kulla shayin AAilman afala tatathakkaroona: knowledge-encompassment demanding reflective response. Allatheena amanoo walam yalbisoo eemanahum bithulmin olaika lahumu alamnu wahum muhtadoona: security-guidance as dual reward for belief unmixed with injustice.

existingTopicOverlap.note: Tawheed-possession producing psychological security and argumentative confidence
Zulm-avoidance as condition for security linking taqwa to existential peace

candidates.urduLabel: الأمن والظلم: إبراهيم يحتج بالهداية الإلهية ولا يخاف الشركاء إلا بمشيئة الرب؛ الرب وسع كل شيء علماً أفلا تتذكرون؛ الذين آمنوا ولم يلبسوا إيمانهم بظلم لهم الأمن وهم مهتدون
candidates.notes: Overlap with tawheed and god-consciousness. Atuhajjoonnee fee Allahi waqad hadani frames debate asymmetry: divine-guidance trumps human argument. Illa an yashaa rabbee shayan exception clause prevents absolute self-confidence maintaining divine-dependence even in fearlessness. WasiaAa-kulla-shayin-AAilman provides epistemic foundation for security: nothing escapes divine awareness therefore nothing threatens outside His permission. Zulm-exclusion condition (walam yalbisoo eemanahum bithulmin) defines true faith as belief-integrity producing both amn (security) and hidayah (guidance) as inseparable outcomes.
